job.job_description:
Join a global leader in ServiceNow solutions.
Work remotely with a global client base.
Be part of an inclusive and award-winning organization.
7 10 yrs of experience applying AI to real-world projects.
Experience in a lead role managing projects or mentoring.
Expertise in Python, SQL, and ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn).
Proficiency with data libraries like Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn.
Cloud experience in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Big data experience with Apache Spark and Snowflake.
Knowledge of NLP using Hugging Face and cloud-based AI services.
Strong DB management and optimization skills.
Experience with Tableau and Power BI.
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, or related field.
Develop, train, and deploy ML models for predictive analytics, classification, and clustering.
Implement AI solutions using TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn.
Integrate Hugging Face transformer models for NLP tasks.
Create chatbot solutions using Microsoft Teams and Azure AI.
Utilize Apache Spark and Snowflake for big data analytics.
Design and optimize ETL pipelines.
Manage databases using SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
Build data visualizations in Tableau and Power BI.
Work with LLMs for conversational AI and summarization.
Develop Agentic AI systems for autonomous decision-making.
Join a collaborative, inclusive, and award-winning team.
Develop, deploy, and maintain scalable AI and machine learning models for enterprise solutions.
